Aminu Jaji on his victory at the recently concluded All Progressives Congress (APC) re-run election for Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency of Zamfara State.
The monarch called on the federal lawmaker to redouble his efforts and dedication to service, and prayed for his total success in the forthcoming 2027 general election.
In a letter dated November 13, 2026, signed on behalf of Sanusi by Khalifa Aliyu Ahmed Abdulfathi, he described Jaji’s success at the re-run election as an affirmation of dedication, hard work, transparency and, above all, general acceptability in his constituency and beyond.
“On behalf of His Royal Highness, the 16th Emir of Kano and the Grand Khalifa of the Tijjaniyyah Movement in Nigeria, Dr. Muhammad Sanusi Lamido Sanusi, CON, we wish to extend our heartfelt congratulations to you on your well-deserved success in the just-concluded re-run election in Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency of Zamfara State,” he stated.
“We, in the Majlis of Shurah of Tariqatu Tijjaniyyah of Nigeria, know your commitment and service to humanity, and we thank Allah for this success. We also call on you to redouble your efforts and dedication to service. We pray for your total success in the forthcoming 2027 general election.”
The Emir prayed for peace and stability in Zamfara State, as well as other parts of the country, while also praying for successful general elections.
